title: Direct images of relatively perfect complexes along proper flat finitely presented maps of spaces are perfect with base change
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms of Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file spaces-more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y flat, proper, of finite presentation between algebraic spaces over a scheme S, and E in D(O_X) which is Y-perfect, the lemma concludes Rf_* E is a perfect object of D(O_Y) and its formation commutes with arbitrary base change. The retained proof is written: base change is exactly Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma base-change-tensor (applied to the two-term complex O_X in degree 0); perfection is reduced to Y = Spec(R) affine etale locally, then a four-step Noetherian limit argument: write R as a filtered colimit of Noetherian rings R_i, descend X to a finite presentation R_i-space (Limits of Spaces, lemma descend-finite-presentation), arrange properness and flatness over R_i (lemmas eventually-proper and descend-flat), descend E to an R_i-perfect E_i (chapter lemma descend-relatively-perfect), and apply the proper-perfect-direct-image theorem (Derived Categories of Spaces, lemma perfect-direct-image) to X_i -> Spec(R_i), transferring perfection back along the already-established base-change isomorphism. Retained author proof at lines 12587-12612.
